summary.text: Aaron Paul is the Republican candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 54A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Brad Tabke (D).
Paul was the Republican nominee for the same seat in 2024, when Tabke won by 14 votes, 10,973 to 10,959.
